# DramaFinder

> Playwright element wrappers for Vaadin web components

DramaFinder provides typed Java wrappers around Vaadin web components for use with Playwright testing. Each wrapper exposes component-specific APIs for interaction and assertion, following accessibility-first lookup patterns using ARIA roles.

## Quick Start

```java
// Find elements by accessible label
TextFieldElement username = TextFieldElement.getByLabel(page, "Username");
ButtonElement submit = ButtonElement.getByText(page, "Submit");

// Interact and assert
username.setValue("john.doe");
username.assertValue("john.doe");
submit.click();
```

## API Reference

The complete public API of every element wrapper (methods, signatures, one-line
descriptions) is auto-generated from source into a single file:

- [api-reference.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parttio/dramafinder/master/skills/vaadin-playwright-test/api-reference.md)

**Do not decompile the DramaFinder jar to find its API — read the file above
(one request) instead.** It is regenerated on every release and cannot drift
from the shipped code.

**No network?** The same file ships inside the jar, which is already in `~/.m2`
once the dependency resolves:

```
JAR=$(ls ~/.m2/repository/org/vaadin/addons/dramafinder/*/dramafinder-*.jar | tail -1)
unzip -p "$JAR" META-INF/dramafinder/START-HERE.md    # short guide, ~4 KB
unzip -p "$JAR" META-INF/dramafinder/api-reference.md # every signature, ~100 KB
unzip -p "$JAR" META-INF/dramafinder/MIGRATION-2.0.md # upgrading tests from 1.x
unzip -p "$JAR" META-INF/dramafinder/MIGRATION-FROM-MOPO.md # moving tests from Mopo
```

Start with `START-HERE.md`: it has a working test skeleton, the tag-to-wrapper
naming rule, and the handful of things that are easy to get wrong.

## Agent helpers

- `ViewOutline.write(page)` (package `org.vaadin.addons.dramafinder.agent`) writes
  `target/agent-report/view-outline.txt`: every Vaadin component on the open page
  with the DramaFinder lookup that reaches it, verified against the page. Run it
  in a throwaway test before writing lookups for a view.
- Every failing test extending `AbstractBasePlaywrightIT` writes a report to
  `target/agent-report/<TestClass>/<testMethod>/` (`failure.txt`, `failure.png`,
  `component-snapshot.txt`, `view-outline.txt`).
- Claude Code skills: `/plugin marketplace add parttio/dramafinder`, then
  `/plugin install vaadin-playwright-test@dramafinder` and
  `/plugin install vaadin-playwright-screenshot@dramafinder`.

## Key Patterns

### Element Lookup
Elements are found using accessible names via ARIA roles:
```java
// By label (most common)
TextFieldElement.getByLabel(page, "Email")
ButtonElement.getByText(page, "Save")
SelectElement.getByLabel(page, "Country")

// Scoped lookup within container
TextFieldElement.getByLabel(formLocator, "Name")
```

### ARIA Roles by Component
- Text fields: `AriaRole.TEXTBOX`
- Number fields: `AriaRole.SPINBUTTON`
- Date/time pickers: `AriaRole.COMBOBOX`
- Buttons: `AriaRole.BUTTON`
- Checkboxes: `AriaRole.CHECKBOX`
- Switches: `AriaRole.SWITCH`
- Checkbox groups / radio groups: `AriaRole.GROUP`, `AriaRole.RADIOGROUP`
- Radio buttons: `AriaRole.RADIO`
- Dialogs: `AriaRole.DIALOG`
- List boxes: `AriaRole.LISTBOX`
- Menus: `AriaRole.MENU`, `AriaRole.MENUITEM`
- Sliders: `AriaRole.SLIDER`

### Assertion Methods
Each element provides assertion methods that auto-retry:
```java
field.assertValue("expected");
field.assertEnabled();
field.assertDisabled();
field.assertRequired();
field.assertInvalid();
dialog.assertOpen();
dialog.assertClosed();
```

### Mixin Interfaces
Common behaviors are provided via interfaces in `element/shared/`:
- `HasLocatorElement` - the underlying Playwright locator (base of every mixin)
- `HasValueElement` - text value get/set/clear/assert through the input slot
- `HasInputFieldElement` - value, label, helper and CSS classes of an input field, combined
- `HasValidationPropertiesElement` - required, invalid, error message
- `HasEnabledElement` - enabled/disabled state, read the way Playwright does
- `HasDisabledAttributeElement` - enabled/disabled state from the `disabled` attribute, for hosts that are not form controls
- `HasReadOnlyElement` - read-only state
- `HasCheckedElement` - checked state of a checkbox-like input
- `FocusableElement` - focus/blur operations
- `HasThemeElement` - theme variant assertions
- `HasStyleElement` - CSS class names
- `HasAriaLabelElement` - `aria-label`
- `HasClearButtonElement` - clear button click
- `HasPlaceholderElement` - placeholder text
- `HasAllowedCharPatternElement` - `allowedCharPattern`
- `HasPrefixElement` - content of the `prefix` slot
- `HasSuffixElement` - content of the `suffix` slot
- `HasTooltipElement` - tooltip content
- `HasLabelElement` - label text
- `HasHelperElement` - helper text

## Build Commands

```bash
# Build with tests
./mvnw clean install

# Run integration tests
./mvnw -Pit verify

# Run single IT test
./mvnw -Dit.test=MyViewIT -Pit verify
```

## Source Code

- Main elements: `src/main/java/org/vaadin/addons/dramafinder/element/`
- Shared mixins: `src/main/java/org/vaadin/addons/dramafinder/element/shared/`
- Integration tests: `src/test/java/**/*IT.java`
